54	def derive_accounts(ci, cell, b, returned, views, scopes, coverages, extents, invs_by_kind, vcs_kind, faults):
55	    """Accounts in owed order (matrix relations array as authored). Returns [(NativeCoverageAccountV1, internal)]."""
56	    U = b["universe"]
57	    state = cell_state(cell["capabilityId"], cell["languageMode"])["state"]
58	    out = []
59	    for rel, rung in CAPS[cell["capabilityId"]]["relations"]:
60	        if rel == "vcs-change" and vcs_kind == "none":
61	            app = "inapplicable-vcs"
62	        elif state == "UNSUPPORTED-TYPED":
63	            app = "unsupported-typed"
64	        elif b["enumerator"]["status"] == "unselected":
65	            app = "unavailable-unselected"
66	        elif U is None:
67	            app = "unavailable-null-universe"
68	        else:
69	            app = "supported-available"
70	        acc = {"cellOrdinal": ci, "programOrdinal": b["ordinal"], "relation": rel, "resolution": rung,
71	               "sourceUniverse": U, "targetUniverse": U, "applicability": app, "coverageIds": []}
72	        internal = {"accountState": None, "deficiency": None, "nativeCause": None, "coverageRecords": [],
73	                    "censusMissing": [], "scopeIds": []}
74	        if app == "supported-available":
75	            cids = set()
76	            for vid in returned:
77	                for cid in views[vid]["coverageIds"]:
78	                    cov, payload = coverages[cid]
79	                    k = payload["key"]
80	                    if k["relation"] != rel or k["resolution"] != rung:
81	                        continue
82	                    if k["sourceUniverse"] != U or scopes[cov["scopeId"]]["sourceUniverse"] != U:
83	                        faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_COVERAGE_DERIVE:foreign-universe:{cid}")
84	                        continue
85	                    cids.add(cid)
86	            cids = sorted(cids, key=lambda x: K.C(x))
87	            acc["coverageIds"] = [sfx(c) for c in cids]
88	            covered = set()
89	            for cid in cids:
90	                cov, payload = coverages[cid]
91	                e = payload["entry"]
92	                internal["coverageRecords"].append({"coverage": sfx(cid), "deficiency": e["deficiency"],
93	                                                    "nativeCause": e["nativeCause"], "coverage_state": e["coverage"]})
94	                covered |= set(scopes[cov["scopeId"]]["subjects"])
95	                internal["scopeIds"].append(cov["scopeId"])
96	            missing = expected_subjects(rel, extents, invs_by_kind) - covered
97	            internal["censusMissing"] = sorted(missing, key=lambda x: x.encode())
98	            complete = bool(cids) and all(r["coverage_state"] == "complete" for r in internal["coverageRecords"]) and not missing
99	            internal["accountState"] = "complete" if complete else "incomplete"
100	            if not complete:
101	                carrier = next(((r["deficiency"], r["nativeCause"]) for r in internal["coverageRecords"] if r["deficiency"] is not None), (None, None))
102	                internal["deficiency"], internal["nativeCause"] = carrier
103	        elif app == "unsupported-typed":
104	            internal["accountState"] = "unsupported"
105	            internal["deficiency"], internal["nativeCause"] = matrix_pair(cell["capabilityId"], cell["languageMode"])
106	        elif app in ("unavailable-unselected", "unavailable-null-universe"):
107	            internal["accountState"] = "unavailable"
108	            internal["deficiency"], internal["nativeCause"] = b.get("deficiency"), b.get("nativeCause")
109	        else:
110	            internal["accountState"] = "inapplicable"
111	        out.append((acc, internal))
112	    return out

115	def derive_outcome(ci, cell, b, obs, ctx, faults):
116	    """obs: host observation for this binding {viewDigests:[view2 ids], stageOrdinal, candidateResultDigest}.
117	    ctx: owner records. Returns (CellProgramOutcomeV1 without ordinal, accounts, requiredRows, sources)."""
118	    U = b["universe"]
119	    po = b["ordinal"]
120	    key = (ci, po)
121	    invs = {k: ctx["enum_index"]["inventories"][(ci, po, k)] for k in cell["kinds"] if (ci, po, k) in ctx["enum_index"]["inventories"]}
122	    invs_by_kind = {k: v[1] for k, v in invs.items()}
123	    inv_digests = sorted({v[0] for v in invs.values()}, key=lambda h: K.C(h))
124	    extents = ctx["enum_index"]["extents"].get(key, {})
125	    unavailable_binding = b["enumerator"]["status"] == "unselected" or U is None
126	    returned = [] if unavailable_binding else list(obs["viewDigests"])
127	    # section 3 joins for returned views of a selected producer
128	    for vid in returned:
129	        v = ctx["views"].get(vid)
130	        if v is None:
131	            faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_REF_POINTER:{vid}")
132	            continue
133	        if v["planId"] != ctx["plan_id"]:
134	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_ORDINAL:view-plan")
135	        if v["producerClosure"] != b["enumerator"]["closureId"]:
136	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_PRODUCER:view-producer")
137	        for sid in v["scopeIds"]:
138	            if ctx["scopes"][sid]["sourceUniverse"] != U:
139	                faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_COVERAGE_DERIVE:scope-universe:{sid}")
140	    returned = [v for v in returned if v in ctx["views"]]
141	    accounts = derive_accounts(ci, cell, b, returned, ctx["views"], ctx["scopes"], ctx["coverages"], extents, invs_by_kind,
142	                               ctx["vcs_kind"], faults)
143	    sources = []
144	    if unavailable_binding:
145	        sources.append({"source": "binding", "relation": None, "resolution": None, "deficiency": b.get("deficiency"),
146	                        "nativeCause": b.get("nativeCause"), "inputRefs": []})
147	    for h in inv_digests:
148	        inv = next(i for d, i in invs.values() if d == h)
149	        if inv["state"] != "complete":
150	            sources.append({"source": "inventory", "relation": None, "resolution": None, "deficiency": inv["deficiency"],
151	                            "nativeCause": inv["nativeCause"], "inputRefs": [{"domain": "subject-inventory", "digest": h}]})
152	    candidate_owed = cell["capabilityId"] in CANDIDATE_CAPS and not unavailable_binding
153	    cand_digest = obs.get("candidateResultDigest") if candidate_owed else None
154	    env = None
155	    if candidate_owed:
156	        if cand_digest is None:
157	            if cell["required"]:
158	                faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED:{ci}:{po}")
159	            sources.append({"source": "candidate", "relation": None, "resolution": None, "deficiency": None,
160	                            "nativeCause": None, "inputRefs": []})
161	        else:
162	            env = ctx["candidates"].get(cand_digest)
163	            if env is None:
164	                faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_REF_LOST_BYTES:candidate:{cand_digest}")
165	            elif env["state"] != "complete":
166	                sources.append({"source": "candidate", "relation": None, "resolution": None, "deficiency": env["deficiency"],
167	                                "nativeCause": env["nativeCause"],
168	                                "inputRefs": [{"domain": "candidate-producer-result", "digest": cand_digest}]})
169	    for acc, internal in accounts:
170	        st = internal["accountState"]
171	        if st == "incomplete":
172	            if internal["coverageRecords"]:
173	                for r in internal["coverageRecords"]:
174	                    sources.append({"source": "coverage", "relation": acc["relation"], "resolution": acc["resolution"],
175	                                    "deficiency": r["deficiency"], "nativeCause": r["nativeCause"],
176	                                    "inputRefs": [{"domain": "coverage", "digest": r["coverage"]}]})
177	            else:
178	                sources.append({"source": "account", "relation": acc["relation"], "resolution": acc["resolution"],
179	                                "deficiency": None, "nativeCause": None,
180	                                "inputRefs": [{"domain": "coverage", "digest": c} for c in acc["coverageIds"]]})
181	        elif st in ("unsupported", "unavailable"):
182	            sources.append({"source": "account-" + st, "relation": acc["relation"], "resolution": acc["resolution"],
183	                            "deficiency": internal["deficiency"], "nativeCause": internal["nativeCause"], "inputRefs": []})
184	    inv_states = [i["state"] for i in invs_by_kind.values()]
185	    if unavailable_binding:
186	        state = "unavailable"
187	    elif candidate_owed and (cand_digest is None or (env is not None and env["state"] == "unavailable")):
188	        state = "unavailable"
189	    elif inv_states and all(s == "unavailable" for s in inv_states) and not returned and (env is None or env["state"] == "unavailable"):
190	        state = "unavailable"
191	    elif any(s != "complete" for s in inv_states) or any(i["accountState"] == "incomplete" for _, i in accounts) or \
192	            (env is not None and env["state"] == "partial"):
193	        state = "partial"
194	    else:
195	        state = "complete"
196	    carrier = (None, None)
197	    if state != "complete":
198	        carrier = next(((s["deficiency"], s["nativeCause"]) for s in sources if s["deficiency"] is not None), (None, None))
199	    stage_ord = None if unavailable_binding else obs.get("stageOrdinal")
200	    null_reason = None
201	    if stage_ord is None:
202	        null_reason = "optional-unselected" if b["enumerator"]["status"] == "unselected" else "unavailable-binding"
203	    if not unavailable_binding and state in ("complete", "partial"):
204	        rec = next((r for r in ctx["receipts"] if r["ordinal"] == stage_ord), None)
205	        if rec is None or rec["state"] != "complete":
206	            faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_ORDINAL:{ci}:{po}")

209	                faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_PRODUCER:{ci}:{po}")

212	                faults.append(f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_ORDINAL:views-not-on-receipt:{ci}:{po}")
213	    outcome = {"cellOrdinal": ci, "programOrdinal": po, "capabilityId": cell["capabilityId"],
214	               "languageMode": cell["languageMode"], "workspaceRoot": cell["workspaceRoot"], "required": cell["required"],
215	               "kinds": sorted(cell["kinds"], key=lambda k: K.C(k)), "universe": U,
216	               "enumeratorStatus": b["enumerator"]["status"], "enumeratorClosure": b["enumerator"].get("closureId"),
217	               "state": state, "deficiency": carrier[0], "nativeCause": carrier[1],
218	               "stageOrdinal": stage_ord, "stageOrdinalNullReason": null_reason,
219	               "inventoryDigests": inv_digests, "viewDigests": sorted([sfx(v) for v in returned], key=lambda h: K.C(h)),
220	               "candidateResultDigest": cand_digest}
221	    required_rows = []
222	    if cell["required"]:
223	        for s in sources:
224	            if s["source"] == "candidate" and not s["inputRefs"] and cand_digest is None:
225	                continue
226	            required_rows.append({"cellOrdinal": ci, "programOrdinal": po, "capabilityId": cell["capabilityId"],
227	                                  "relation": s["relation"], "resolution": s["resolution"], "source": s["source"],
228	                                  "deficiency": s["deficiency"], "nativeCause": s["nativeCause"], "universe": U,
229	                                  "inputRefs": cset(s["inputRefs"])})
230	    return outcome, accounts, cset(required_rows), sources

233	def derive(enum_plan, observations, ctx, faults):
234	    """observations: {(ci, po): {viewDigests, stageOrdinal, candidateResultDigest}} (host observation fields)."""
235	    outcomes, accounts, required, internal_accounts = [], [], [], []
236	    for ci, cell in enumerate(enum_plan["cells"]):
237	        for b in cell["programBindings"]:
238	            obs = observations.get((ci, b["ordinal"]), {"viewDigests": [], "stageOrdinal": None, "candidateResultDigest": None})
239	            o, accs, rows, _ = derive_outcome(ci, cell, b, obs, ctx, faults)
240	            outcomes.append(dict({"ordinal": len(outcomes)}, **o))
241	            accounts += [a for a, _ in accs]
242	            internal_accounts += [dict(i, cellOrdinal=ci, programOrdinal=b["ordinal"], relation=a["relation"],
243	                                       resolution=a["resolution"], applicability=a["applicability"]) for a, i in accs]
244	            required += rows
245	    host_derived = []
246	    for o in outcomes:
247	        host_derived += [{"domain": "subject-inventory", "digest": d} for d in o["inventoryDigests"]]
248	        if o["candidateResultDigest"]:
249	            host_derived.append({"domain": "candidate-producer-result", "digest": o["candidateResultDigest"]})
250	    host_derived = cset(host_derived + ctx.get("sidecar_refs", []))
251	    stage_refs = [r for rec in ctx["receipts"] if rec["state"] == "complete" for r in rec["outputRefs"]]
252	    cov_refs = [{"domain": "coverage", "digest": sfx(c)} for r in stage_refs if r["domain"] == "view"
253	                for c in ctx["views"]["view2:" + r["digest"]]["coverageIds"]]
254	    imports = [{"domain": "import", "digest": sfx(i)} for i in ctx["plan"]["importIds"]]
255	    selected = cset(stage_refs + cov_refs + host_derived + imports)
256	    return {"outcomes": outcomes, "accounts": accounts, "internalAccounts": internal_accounts,
257	            "requiredRows": cset(required), "hostDerivedRefs": host_derived, "selectedRefs": selected,
258	            "candidateResultRefs": sorted({o["candidateResultDigest"] for o in outcomes if o["candidateResultDigest"]}, key=lambda h: K.C(h))}

261	def bridge(required_rows, xi_ref):
262	    """composition s9.6 steps 1-7."""
263	    items = []
264	    for row in required_rows:
265	        d = row["deficiency"]
266	        if d in EXEC_REGISTRY:
267	            cause = d
268	        elif d is None or d == "source-syntax-invalid":
269	            cause = "required-cell-unsatisfied"
270	        else:
271	            raise K.AdmissionError("EVALUATOR_EXECUTION_CAUSE_UNREGISTERED", str(d))
272	        items.append({"source": "execution", "cause": cause, "subjectId": None, "predicateId": None,
273	                      "inputRefs": cset([xi_ref] + row["inputRefs"]), "evidenceKind": None,
274	                      "nativeCause": row["nativeCause"], "universe": row["universe"]})
275	    return cset(items)

279	    """Synthetic host capture (s8 intent): derive claim states from owner records; never invents Coverage."""

292	def admit(claimed, plan, plan_id, exec_plan, exec_plan_id, enum_plan, closures, stage_specs, ctx):
293	    """Re-derives from owner records + claimed OBSERVATION fields; returns (faults, derived)."""
294	    faults = []
295	    r = KIT.admit(claimed, XI_DOC, "#")
296	    if not r["ok"]:
297	        return [f"EXECUTION_INPUTS_SCHEMA:{r['typed']}{r['stock'][:1]}{r['order'][:1]}"], None
298	    if claimed["planId"] != plan_id:
299	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_PLAN_JOIN")
300	    if claimed["executionPlanId"] != exec_plan_id:
301	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_EXECUTION_PLAN_JOIN")
302	    if claimed["enumerationPlanDigest"] != K.raw_digest(enum_plan):
303	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_ENUMERATION_DIGEST")
304	    if claimed["analysisSpecDigest"] != plan["analysisSpecDigest"]:
305	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_PLAN_JOIN:analysisSpecDigest")
306	    ev = closures.get(claimed["evaluatorClosure"])
307	    if claimed["evaluatorClosure"] not in plan["semanticClosures"] or ev is None or ev["kind"] != "evaluator":
308	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_EVALUATOR_CLOSURE")
309	    receipts = claimed["hostCapture"]["stageReceipts"]
310	    if [x["ordinal"] for x in receipts] != [s["ordinal"] for s in exec_plan["stages"]]:
311	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_RECEIPT_TOTALITY")
312	    for rec, stage in zip(receipts, exec_plan["stages"]):
313	        spec = stage_specs.get(stage["stageSpecDigest"])
314	        if rec["stageSpecDigest"] != stage["stageSpecDigest"] or spec is None:
315	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_ORDINAL:spec")
316	            continue
317	        if rec["producerClosure"] != spec["producerClosure"]:
318	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_PRODUCER")
319	        if sorted(rec["outputDomains"]) != sorted(stage["outputDomains"]):
320	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_ORDINAL:outputDomains")
321	        if any(o["domain"] not in rec["outputDomains"] for o in rec["outputRefs"]):
322	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_STAGE_ORDINAL:outputRefs")
323	        for o in rec["outputRefs"]:
324	            if o["domain"] == "view" and "view2:" + o["digest"] not in ctx["views"]:
325	                faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_REF_LOST_BYTES:view")
326	    observations = {}
327	    bindings = [(ci, b["ordinal"]) for ci, c in enumerate(enum_plan["cells"]) for b in c["programBindings"]]
328	    if len(claimed["cellOutcomes"]) != len(bindings):
329	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_OUTCOME_TOTALITY")
330	    for row in claimed["cellOutcomes"]:
331	        observations[(row["cellOrdinal"], row["programOrdinal"])] = {
332	            "viewDigests": ["view2:" + h for h in row["viewDigests"]], "stageOrdinal": row["stageOrdinal"],
333	            "candidateResultDigest": row["candidateResultDigest"]}
334	    dctx = dict(ctx, receipts=receipts, plan=plan, plan_id=plan_id)
335	    derived = derive(enum_plan, observations, dctx, faults)
336	    if claimed["cellOutcomes"] != derived["outcomes"]:
337	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_OUTCOME_DERIVE")
338	    if sorted(map(K.C, claimed["nativeCoverageAccounts"])) != sorted(map(K.C, derived["accounts"])):
339	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_COVERAGE_DERIVE")
340	    if claimed["selectedRefs"] != derived["selectedRefs"]:
341	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_SELECTED_COVER")
342	    if any(x["domain"] in FORBIDDEN_SELECTED for x in claimed["selectedRefs"]):
343	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_SELECTED_FORBIDDEN")
344	    if claimed["hostCapture"]["hostDerivedRefs"] != derived["hostDerivedRefs"]:
345	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_HOST_DERIVED")
346	    if claimed["candidateResultRefs"] != derived["candidateResultRefs"]:
347	        faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_CANDIDATE_BIND")
348	    for d in derived["candidateResultRefs"]:
349	        env = ctx["candidates"].get(d)
350	        if env is None:
351	            continue
352	        o = next(o for o in derived["outcomes"] if o["candidateResultDigest"] == d)
353	        if env["planId"] != plan_id or env["executionPlanId"] != exec_plan_id or env["cellOrdinal"] != o["cellOrdinal"] or \
354	                env["programOrdinal"] != o["programOrdinal"] or env["capabilityId"] != o["capabilityId"] or \
355	                env["languageMode"] != o["languageMode"] or env["universe"] != o["universe"] or \
356	                env["producerClosure"] != o["enumeratorClosure"]:
357	            faults.append("EXECUTION_INPUTS_CANDIDATE_BIND:join")
358	    try:
359	        bridge(derived["requiredRows"], {"domain": "execution-inputs", "digest": K.raw_digest(claimed)})
360	    except K.AdmissionError as exc:
361	        faults.append(exc.boundary)
362	    return faults, derived

225	    faults = []
226	    r = KIT.admit(fact, ID, "#/$defs/fact")
227	    if not r["ok"]:
228	        return [f"FACT_SCHEMA:{r['stock'][:1]}{r['order'][:1]}{r['typed']}"], None
229	    if fact["snapshotId"] != snapshot_id:
230	        faults.append("REFERENCE_SOURCE_JOIN")
231	    rel, rung = fact["relation"], fact["resolution"]
232	    if rel not in RELS:
233	        return faults + ["RELATION_UNREGISTERED"], None
234	    row = RELS[rel]
235	    if rung not in row["ladder"]:
236	        faults.append("FACT_RUNG_NOT_IN_RELATION_LADDER")
237	    payload, pf = admit_fact_payload(store, fact)
238	    faults += pf
239	    if payload is None:
240	        return faults, None
241	    rules = row["rungs"].get(rung, {"required": [], "forbidden": []})
242	    for f in rules["required"]:
243	        if f not in payload:
244	            faults.append(f"FACT_RUNG_FIELD_REQUIRED:{f}")
245	    for f in rules["forbidden"]:
246	        if f in payload:
247	            faults.append(f"FACT_RUNG_FIELD_FORBIDDEN:{f}")
248	    if row["universeRule"] == "same-only" and fact["sourceUniverse"] != fact["targetUniverse"]:
249	        faults.append("FACT_UNIVERSE_RULE")
250	    for u in (fact["sourceUniverse"], fact["targetUniverse"]):
251	        if u not in bound_by_hex:
252	            faults.append("FACT_UNIVERSE_NOT_PLAN_SELECTED")
253	    law = row["anchorLaw"]
254	    n = len(fact["anchors"])
255	    if (law["class"] == "source-text" and n < 1) or (law["class"] in ("body-identity", "inventory") and n != law["cardinality"]):
256	        return faults + ["FACT_ANCHOR_CARDINALITY"], payload
257	    inv = inv_map(inventory)
258	    for a in fact["anchors"]:
259	        irow = inv.get(a["path"])
260	        if irow is None or irow["sha256"] != a["blobDigest"]:
261	            faults.append("ANCHOR_SOURCE")
262	            continue
263	        b = store.blobs.get(a["blobDigest"])
264	        if b is None:
265	            faults.append("EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE:anchor-blob")
266	            continue
267	        if not (0 <= a["startByte"] <= a["endByte"] <= len(b)):
268	            faults.append("ANCHOR_RANGE")
269	            continue
270	        try:
271	            b[a["startByte"]:a["endByte"]].decode("utf-8")
272	            if a["startByte"] < len(b) and (b[a["startByte"]] & 0xC0) == 0x80:
273	                raise UnicodeDecodeError("utf-8", b, a["startByte"], a["startByte"] + 1, "split")
274	        except UnicodeDecodeError:
275	            faults.append("ANCHOR_UTF8")
276	    for j in row["snapshotJoins"]:
277	        if j.get("unless") and payload.get(j["unless"]["field"]) == j["unless"]["equals"]:
278	            continue
279	        p = payload.get(j["pathField"])
280	        irow = inv.get(p)
281	        if irow is None:
282	            faults.append(f"SNAPSHOT_JOIN_PATH:{rel}")
283	            continue
284	        if j["form"] == "inventoried-file":
285	            if payload[j["digestField"]] != irow["sha256"]:
286	                faults.append("SNAPSHOT_JOIN_DIGEST")
287	            if payload[j["lengthField"]] != irow["bytes"]:
288	                faults.append("SNAPSHOT_JOIN_LENGTH")
289	            b = store.blobs.get(irow["sha256"])
290	            if b is None:
291	                faults.append("EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE:inventoried-file")
292	            elif hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() != irow["sha256"] or len(b) != irow["bytes"]:
293	                faults.append("SNAPSHOT_JOIN_RETAINED_BYTES")
294	    bound = bound_by_hex.get(fact["sourceUniverse"])
295	    if bound is not None:
296	        cap = f"{rel}@{rung}"
297	        if bound["domain"] == "native.semantic-universe.syntax.v2" and cap not in INVENTORY_CAPS:
298	            for a in fact["anchors"]:
299	                g, caps = syntax_path_capabilities(bound, a["path"])
300	                if cap not in caps:
301	                    faults.append("SYNTAX_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED_FACT")
302	        if rel == "clones":
303	            faults += clones_join_faults(store, fact, payload, bound)
304	    if fact["confidenceMillionths"] != 1000000:
305	        faults.append("cb24.NATIVE_CONFIDENCE_EMISSION_LAW")

401	    """admit_coverage_result_v3 over retained bytes (producer boundary re-run at closure)."""
402	    faults = []

404	    if not r["ok"]:
405	        return ["COVERAGE_SCHEMA"], None
406	    if coverage["scopeId"] != scope_id:
407	        faults.append("native.coverage-subject-scope-outside-view")

409	        faults.append("native.coverage-payload-schema-not-registered")
410	    if coverage["payloadDigest"] not in store.blobs:
411	        return faults + ["EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE:coverage-payload"], None
412	    payload = store.get_record(coverage["payloadDigest"])
413	    pr = KIT.admit(payload, NE, "#/$defs/CoverageResultV3")
414	    if not pr["ok"]:
415	        return faults + [f"COVERAGE_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA:{pr['stock'][:1]}{pr['order'][:1]}"], payload
416	    key, entry = payload["key"], payload["entry"]
417	    for f in ("relation", "resolution", "sourceUniverse", "targetUniverse"):
418	        if key[f] != scope[f]:

420	    if key["subjectScopeCommitment"] != "sha256:" + scope_id.split(":", 1)[1]:
421	        faults.append("native.subject-scope-commitment-mismatch")
422	    if entry["examinedUniverse"]["subjectScopeCommitment"] != key["subjectScopeCommitment"]:
423	        faults.append("native.examined-universe-commitment-mismatch")
424	    if entry["examinedUniverse"]["subjectCount"] != len(scope["subjects"]):
425	        faults.append("native.examined-universe-subject-count-mismatch")
426	    if entry["relation"] != key["relation"] or entry["resolution"] != key["resolution"]:
427	        faults.append("native.coverage-entry-key-mismatch")
428	    rel, rung = key["relation"], key["resolution"]
429	    if not ladder_ok(rel, rung):
430	        return faults + ["native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-0"], payload
431	    rc = entry["resolutionCompleteness"]
432	    if rung in RESOLVED:
433	        subjects = set(scope["subjects"])
434	        edges = [p for (f, p) in view_facts_payloads if f["relation"] == "unresolved-edge" and p["relation"] == rel and p["referrer"] in subjects]
435	        st = rc["state"]
436	        classes = sorted({p["edgeKind"] for p in edges})
437	        if st == "not-applicable":
438	            faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-1-resolved-not-applicable")
439	        elif st == "complete":
440	            if not (rc["attempted"] and rc["examinedExhaustive"] and rc["stageTerminal"] == "complete" and not edges):
441	                faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-2-complete")
442	        elif st == "incomplete":

444	                faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-2-incomplete")
445	        elif st == "partial":
446	            if not (rc["attempted"] and (rc["stageTerminal"] in ("unavailable", "budget-exhausted", "provider-fault", "cancelled", "crash") or not rc["examinedExhaustive"])):
447	                faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-2-partial")
448	        elif st == "not-attempted":
449	            if rc["attempted"] or rc["unresolvedEdgeCount"] != 0:
450	                faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-2-not-attempted")
451	        if st in ("complete", "incomplete") and (rc["unresolvedEdgeCount"] != len(edges) or rc["unresolvedEdgeClasses"] != classes):
452	            faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-2-edge-account")
453	    else:
454	        if rc["state"] != "not-applicable" or rc["attempted"] or rc["unresolvedEdgeCount"] != 0 or rc["unresolvedEdgeClasses"]:
455	            faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-1-non-resolved")
456	    if entry["coverage"] == "complete" and not rc["examinedExhaustive"]:
457	        faults.append("native.coverage-bijection-mismatch:RC-6")
458	    faults += cause_registry_faults(entry, rel)
459	    owed = owed_disclosure(scope, bound, inventory)
460	    if owed is not None:

462	        # COVERAGE_SOURCE_VARIANT_UNSUPPORTED_SCOPE, COVERAGE_DIALECT_PREREQUISITE / _DEFICIENCY_MISMATCH / _CAUSE_MISMATCH.
463	        # The syntax/source-variant mismatch and every "undisclosed" variant are NOT spelled out by the kit; this
464	        # reconstruction names them under cb24. (helper correction HC-KEYNAMES; see notes/02 advisory).
465	        (od, oc), name = owed

473	        elif entry["deficiency"] != od:
474	            faults.append(f"{family}_DEFICIENCY_MISMATCH" if published else f"cb24.{family}_DEFICIENCY_MISMATCH")
475	        elif entry["nativeCause"] != oc:
476	            faults.append(f"{family}_CAUSE_MISMATCH" if published else f"cb24.{family}_CAUSE_MISMATCH")

48	def admit_closure(store, closure_id, want_kind=None, refusal_prefix="native.native-context-closure"):
49	    """closure2 identity recomputed from the retained frame; kind checked; every tree blob retained at its
50	    declared length (BLOB_LENGTH); manifest body bytes retained (raw-artifact preimage)."""
51	    if not isinstance(closure_id, str) or not closure_id.startswith("closure2:"):
52	        raise Refusal(f"{refusal_prefix}-unretained", str(closure_id))
53	    hx = closure_id.split(":", 1)[1]
54	    if hx not in store.blobs:
55	        raise Refusal(f"{refusal_prefix}-unretained", closure_id)
56	    try:
57	        domain, desc = store.get_frame(hx, {"closure"})
58	    except K.AdmissionError as exc:
59	        raise Refusal(f"{refusal_prefix}-identity-mismatch", exc.boundary)
60	    if K.H("closure", desc) != hx:
61	        raise Refusal(f"{refusal_prefix}-identity-mismatch", closure_id)
62	    schema_or_refuse(desc, ID, "#/$defs/closure", "cb24.closure-schema")
63	    if want_kind is not None and desc["kind"] != want_kind:
64	        raise Refusal(f"{refusal_prefix}-kind-mismatch", f"{closure_id}:{desc['kind']}!={want_kind}")
65	    for row in desc["tree"]:
66	        b = store.blobs.get(row["sha256"])
67	        if b is None:
68	            raise Refusal("EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE", f"closure-tree:{row['path']}")
69	        if len(b) != row["bytes"]:
70	            raise Refusal("BLOB_LENGTH", row["path"])
71	    if desc["manifestDigest"] not in store.blobs:
72	        raise Refusal("EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE", "closure.manifestDigest")
73	    return desc

303	def config_graph_faults(graph, ctx, inventory):
304	    faults = []
305	    inv = inv_map(inventory)
306	    paths = [n["path"] for n in graph["nodes"]]
307	    if set(paths) != set(ctx["configProjection"]["configGraphPaths"]):
308	        faults.append("cb24.config-graph-paths-contradict-context")
309	    byp = {n["path"]: n for n in graph["nodes"]}
310	    for n in graph["nodes"]:
311	        base = n["path"].split("/")[-1]
312	        want = KIND_LAW["basenames"].get(base, KIND_LAW["otherwise"])
313	        if n["kind"] != want:
314	            faults.append(f"native.config-graph-kind-contradicts-path:{n['path']}")
315	        row = inv.get(n["path"])
316	        if row is None or row["sha256"] != n["contentSha256"]:
317	            faults.append(f"cb24.config-graph-node-not-inventoried:{n['path']}")
318	        for e in n["extendsResolved"]:
319	            if e not in byp:
320	                faults.append(f"cb24.config-graph-edge-unbound:{n['path']}->{e}")
321	    entry = graph["entryConfigPath"]
322	    if entry is None:
323	        if graph["nodes"]:
324	            faults.append("cb24.config-graph-synthesized-with-nodes")
325	    else:
326	        if entry not in byp:
327	            faults.append("cb24.config-graph-entry-not-a-node")
328	        else:
329	            seen, stack, onstack = set(), [], set()
330	
331	            def dfs(p):
332	                if p in onstack:
333	                    faults.append(f"cb24.config-graph-cycle:{p}")
334	                    return
335	                if p in seen:
336	                    return
337	                seen.add(p)
338	                onstack.add(p)
339	                for e in byp[p]["extendsResolved"]:
340	                    if e in byp:
341	                        dfs(e)
342	                onstack.discard(p)
343	            dfs(entry)
344	            for p in byp:
345	                if p not in seen:
346	                    faults.append(f"cb24.config-graph-node-unreachable:{p}")
347	    return faults

67	def fn_span(data, name):
68	    i = data.index(b"fn " + name.encode())
69	    if data[max(0, i - 4):i] == b"pub ":
70	        i -= 4
71	    s = data.index(b"{", i)
72	    depth = 0
73	    for j in range(s, len(data)):
74	        if data[j:j + 1] == b"{":
75	            depth += 1
76	        elif data[j:j + 1] == b"}":
77	            depth -= 1
78	            if depth == 0:
79	                return i, s, j + 1
80	    raise ValueError(name)

86	def body_span(data):

92	        elif data[i:i + 1] == b"}":
93	            depth -= 1

52	def _walk(schema, inst, resolver, path, parent, annotated, hexes, depth):
53	    if depth > 200 or not isinstance(schema, dict):
54	        return
55	    if isinstance(inst, str):
56	        if "x-opensip-digest" in schema:
57	            annotated.setdefault(path, (inst, schema["x-opensip-digest"], parent))
58	        if schema.get("pattern") == HEX64:
59	            hexes[path] = inst
60	    if "$ref" in schema:
61	        r = resolver.lookup(schema["$ref"])
62	        _walk(r.contents, inst, r.resolver, path, parent, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
63	    for sub in schema.get("allOf", []):
64	        _walk(sub, inst, resolver, path, parent, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
65	    for key in ("anyOf", "oneOf"):
66	        for sub in schema.get(key, []):
67	            if KIT._is_valid(sub, inst, resolver):
68	                _walk(sub, inst, resolver, path, parent, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
69	    if "if" in schema:
70	        if KIT._is_valid(schema["if"], inst, resolver):
71	            if "then" in schema:
72	                _walk(schema["then"], inst, resolver, path, parent, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
73	        elif "else" in schema:
74	            _walk(schema["else"], inst, resolver, path, parent, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
75	    if isinstance(inst, list) and isinstance(schema.get("items"), dict):
76	        for i, item in enumerate(inst):
77	            _walk(schema["items"], item, resolver, f"{path}[{i}]", parent, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
78	    if isinstance(inst, dict):
79	        props = schema.get("properties", {})
80	        for k, v in inst.items():
81	            if k in props:
82	                _walk(props[k], v, resolver, f"{path}.{k}", inst, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)
83	            elif isinstance(schema.get("additionalProperties"), dict):
84	                _walk(schema["additionalProperties"], v, resolver, f"{path}.{k}", inst, annotated, hexes, depth + 1)

"""Preserve the ORIGINAL (pre-correction) ported helper sources and every Run store/build/replay produced by them under the
source39 kit, before any helper correction is applied. Copies are byte-exact; a manifest records each SHA-256.

Destination: output/preserved/s39-original/{ref,builders,tools,runs}/... plus manifest.json. Refuses to overwrite an existing
preserved set, so the original bytes can never be replaced by corrected ones.
Usage: python3 tools/seq.py <label> tools/preserve_original.py
"""
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys

OUT = "/private/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/consumer-b.v24-source39.v1/output"
DST = OUT + "/preserved/s39-original"


def main():
    if os.path.exists(DST + "/manifest.json"):
        print("preserved set already exists; not overwritten")
        return 0
    rows = []
    patterns = ["ref/*.py", "builders/*.py", "tools/*.py", "vectors/*.py", "runs/*.json"]
    for pat in patterns:
        for src in sorted(glob.glob(f"{OUT}/{pat}")):
            rel = os.path.relpath(src, OUT)
            dst = f"{DST}/{rel}"
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
            b = open(dst, "rb").read()
            rows.append({"path": rel, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(b)})
    manifest = {"standing": ("Original ported helpers and the Runs they built under the source39 kit, before any source39 helper "
                             "correction. Original closure outcome: every one of 26 Runs refused at owning-schema admission "
                             "(execution-inputs /nativeCoverageAccounts/0/targetUniverse not null); logs/s39-original*.log."),
                "files": rows}
    with open(DST + "/manifest.json", "w") as fh:
        json.dump(manifest, fh, indent=1)
    print(json.dumps({"preserved": len(rows), "destination": os.path.relpath(DST, OUT)}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

384	def render_all(out, host):
385	    resp, term = out["response"], out["termination"]
386	    c = resp["context"]
387	    qr = {"kind": "query", "items": len(resp["items"]), "truncated": c["truncated"], "completenessMet": c["countBasis"] == "exact", "advisory": False}
388	    if "nextCursor" in c:

390	    env = {"schemaFamily": "opensip.product.envelope", "schemaMajor": 3, "kind": "query", "requestId": host["requestId"], "projectId": c["projectId"],
391	           "termination": term, "exitCode": P7.EXIT[term["class"]], "query": qr}
392	    probe_ok, probe_errs = P7.admit(dict(env, queryResponse=resp), P7.ENV3, "#")
393	    pf = parity_fields(resp, term)
394	    json_r = K.C({"envelope": env, "queryResponse": resp}).decode()
395	    human = "\n".join([f"resolved-view: {c['resolvedView']['runId']}", f"availability: {c['availability']}", f"truncated: {str(c['truncated']).lower()}",
396	                       f"total-items: {c['totalItems']}", f"termination-class: {term['class']}", "query-response: " + K.C(resp).decode()])
397	    agent_r = K.C({"envelope": dict(env, agentHints=["graph rows are stored-edge results; zero rows do not prove absence"]), "queryResponse": resp}).decode()
398	    return {"envelope": env, "envelopeFaults": P7.check_envelope(env), "queryResponseCarrierProbe": {"admitted": probe_ok, "errors": probe_errs},

402	def parse_rendering(fmt, text):
403	    if fmt in ("json", "agent"):
404	        o = json.loads(text)
405	        return parity_fields(o["queryResponse"], o["envelope"]["termination"]), o["envelope"]
406	    lines = dict(line.split(": ", 1) for line in text.split("\n"))
407	    resp = json.loads(lines["query-response"])
408	    return {"resolved-view": {"runId": lines["resolved-view"]}, "availability": lines["availability"], "truncated": lines["truncated"] == "true",
409	            "total-items": int(lines["total-items"]), "termination-class": lines["termination-class"], "query-response": resp}, None

412	def summary_join_faults(env, resp):
413	    f = []
414	    c, q = resp["context"], env["query"]
415	    if q["items"] != len(resp["items"]):
416	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_SUMMARY_ITEMS")
417	    if q["truncated"] != c["truncated"]:
418	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_SUMMARY_TRUNCATED")
419	    if q["advisory"] is not False:
420	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_SUMMARY_ADVISORY")
421	    if q.get("nextCursor") != c.get("nextCursor"):
422	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_SUMMARY_CURSOR")
423	    if q["completenessMet"] != (c["countBasis"] == "exact"):
424	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_SUMMARY_COMPLETENESS")
425	    if "termination" in resp and resp["termination"] != env["termination"]:
426	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_RESPONSE_TERMINATION_DIFFERS")
427	    if env.get("projectId") != c["projectId"]:
428	        f.append("cb24.QUERY_PROJECT_DIFFERS")
429	    return f

"""Build every declared input-mutation variant, then close and replay EVERY exported Run store in a fresh reference-interpreter
process, writing runs/<name>.replay.json (claimed positives, designed negatives and mutations; attempt copies containing '.' are
skipped) and runs/replay-all.summary.json.

The mutation lists are the builders' own MUTATIONS sets over their base variants (ts-pass, rust-mixed, syntax-code). A builder that
refuses its own mutated inputs before exporting a store is recorded as a build refusal, not hidden.
Usage: python3 tools/seq.py <label> tools/replay_all.py [--no-build]
"""
import glob
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

OUT = "/private/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/consumer-b.v24-source39.v1/output"
REF = ["/tmp/opensip-architecture-review-env/bin/python", "-I", "-B"]
sys.path.insert(0, OUT + "/ref")
sys.path.insert(0, OUT + "/builders")
BASES = (("ts_runs", "ts-pass"), ("rust_runs", "rust-mixed"), ("syntax_runs", "syntax-code"))


def main():
    summary = {"builds": [], "replays": []}
    if "--no-build" not in sys.argv:
        for module, base in BASES:
            mutations = sorted(__import__(module).MUTATIONS)
            for mut in mutations:
                variant = f"{base}~{mut}"
                p = subprocess.run(REF + [f"{OUT}/builders/{module}.py", variant], capture_output=True, text=True)
                summary["builds"].append({"variant": variant, "exit": p.returncode,
                                          "stored": os.path.exists(f"{OUT}/runs/{variant}.store.json"), "tail": (p.stdout + p.stderr)[-800:]})
    for store in sorted(glob.glob(f"{OUT}/runs/*.store.json")):
        name = os.path.basename(store)[:-len(".store.json")]
        if "." in name:
            continue
        dst = f"{OUT}/runs/{name}.replay.json"
        if os.path.exists(dst):
            os.remove(dst)
        p = subprocess.run(REF + [f"{OUT}/tools/replay_run.py", store, dst], capture_output=True, text=True)
        rep = json.load(open(dst)) if os.path.exists(dst) else {}
        faults = rep.get("graphAdmission", {}).get("faults", []) + rep.get("semanticReplay", {}).get("faults", [])
        summary["replays"].append({"run": name, "exit": p.returncode, "result": rep.get("result"), "firstFault": faults[0] if faults else None,
                                   "faultCount": len(faults), "stderrTail": p.stderr[-400:] if not rep else None})
    with open(f"{OUT}/runs/replay-all.summary.json", "w") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    for b in summary["builds"]:
        if b["exit"] or not b["stored"]:
            print("BUILD", b["variant"], b["exit"], b["tail"][-300:].replace("\n", " | "))
    for r in summary["replays"]:
        print(r["run"], r["result"], r["firstFault"])
    missing = [r["run"] for r in summary["replays"] if r["result"] is None]
    print("replays", len(summary["replays"]), "without-result", missing)
    return 1 if missing else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

90	def project(findings, proof, policy, emission):
91	    waived = set(proof["waivedFindingIds"])
92	    bind = {r["ruleId"]: r for r in emission["rules"]}
93	    matched, unmatched = {}, []
94	    for o in findings:
95	        f = o["finding"]
96	        rid = f["ruleId"]
97	        if f["fingerprint"] is None:
98	            u = {"findingId": o["findingId"], "ruleId": rid, "subjectId": f["subjectId"], "subjectPath": f["subject"]["logicalPath"],
99	                 "severity": f["severity"], "waived": o["findingId"] in waived}
100	            if f["correspondence"]["reason"]:
101	                u["correspondenceReason"] = f["correspondence"]["reason"]
102	            unmatched.append(u)
103	            continue
104	        b = bind[rid]
105	        entry = {"fingerprint": f["fingerprint"], "ruleId": rid, "detectorId": detector_id(b), "stabilityClass": b["stabilityClass"],
106	                 "subjectPath": f["subject"]["logicalPath"], "waived": o["findingId"] in waived}
107	        prev = matched.get(f["fingerprint"])
108	        if prev is not None and prev != entry:
109	            raise Refusal("BASELINE.ENTRY_PROJECTION_CONFLICT", f["fingerprint"])
110	        matched[f["fingerprint"]] = entry
111	    rules = {r["ruleId"]: r for r in policy["rules"]}
112	    results = {r["ruleId"]: r for r in proof["ruleResults"]}
113	    roots = {}
114	    for p in proof["predicateProofs"]:

123	                proof["evaluationState"] == "evaluated" and all(v in ("true", "false") for v in roots.get(rid, [])):
124	            negative[rid] = False

"""Retire Run stores built by an own tool error so they cannot be read as measurements, keeping their bytes and outcomes.

The first version of tools/replay_all.py built the Rust designed-negative mutations ambiguous-fact-present and partial-fact-present
over rust-mixed, whose ownership is neither ambiguous nor partial, so the mutation changed nothing and the Runs admitted
(logs/s39-replay-all.0.replay_all.log). This origin's prior runtime built them over rust-ambiguous / rust-partial (HC-27). The files are
moved, never deleted, to preserved/s39-tool-error/ with a SHA-256 manifest.
Usage: python3 tools/seq.py <label> tools/retire_tool_error_runs.py
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys

OUT = "/private/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/consumer-b.v24-source39.v1/output"
DST = OUT + "/preserved/s39-tool-error"
NAMES = ["rust-mixed~ambiguous-fact-present", "rust-mixed~partial-fact-present"]


def main():
    os.makedirs(DST, exist_ok=True)
    mpath = DST + "/manifest.json"
    manifest = json.load(open(mpath)) if os.path.exists(mpath) else {
        "standing": "Runs built over the wrong base variant by an own tool error (HC-27); outcomes are not measurements of the mutation.",
        "files": []}
    for name in NAMES:
        for suffix in (".store.json", ".build.json", ".replay.json"):
            src = f"{OUT}/runs/{name}{suffix}"
            if not os.path.exists(src):
                continue
            data = open(src, "rb").read()
            shutil.move(src, f"{DST}/{name}{suffix}")
            manifest["files"].append({"path": f"runs/{name}{suffix}", "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(data)})
    with open(mpath, "w") as fh:
        json.dump(manifest, fh, indent=1)
    print(json.dumps({"retired": len(manifest["files"]), "destination": os.path.relpath(DST, OUT)}))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def presence(view, fp, rid, path, scope_doc):
    """HC-26: evaluator3 comparison-result $defs/PivotPresence and workflows s3 lines 376-400 for a pivot or the current side.
    true = known matched occurrence; false = non-selection (rule not enabled, or its include/exclude or that side's ScopeDocument does
    not select the path) or evaluated absence (complete-hit-set and no unmatched occurrence of the same rule on the same path, the
    barrier that applies where no stronger relation is retained); null = not known."""
    if fp in view["matched"]:
        return True
    rule = view["rules"].get(rid)
    if rule is None or not rule["enabled"]:
        return False
    se = rule["subjectEnumeration"]
    if not EV.rule_enumeration_selects(se.get("include"), se.get("exclude"), path) or \
            (scope_doc is not None and not EV.scope_document_selects(scope_doc, path)):
        return False
    if view["negative"].get(rid) != "complete-hit-set" or any(u["ruleId"] == rid and u["subjectPath"] == path for u in view["unmatched"]):
        return None
    return False


def baseline_presence(d, fp, rid, path):
    """HC-26: B presence from the artifact alone - an entry is true; non-selection under the embedded baseline policy/ScopeDocument is
    false; evaluated absence requires RuleCoverage.absenceKnowledge=complete-hit-set and no retained unmatchedOccurrences row of the
    same rule and path; otherwise null."""
    if any(e["fingerprint"] == fp for e in d["entries"]):
        return True
    rule = next((r for r in d["contextDocuments"]["policy"]["rules"] if r["ruleId"] == rid), None)
    if rule is None or not rule["enabled"]:
        return False
    se = rule["subjectEnumeration"]
    if not EV.rule_enumeration_selects(se.get("include"), se.get("exclude"), path) or \
            not EV.scope_document_selects(d["contextDocuments"]["scope"], path):
        return False
    rc = next((r for r in d["ruleCoverage"] if r["ruleId"] == rid), None)
    if rc is None or rc["absenceKnowledge"] != "complete-hit-set" or \
            any(u["ruleId"] == rid and u["subjectPath"] == path for u in d["unmatchedOccurrences"]):
        return None
    return False
